notes.title: "Tribe: Primitive Builder" Available Now!

It's been an exhilarating journey, and we can't wait to take you back in time to the age of primitive tribes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bf46bc5227b765e378b28d0748ad802dc682175d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Security Guard devlog#1 - Become the guard !
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

Welcome to the first edition of the [i]Security Guard[/i] Devlog! We're thrilled to introduce you to our brand new game from the simulation category,

Get ready to embark on exciting missions, equip yourself with cutting-edge tools, and explore diverse locations. 
Let's dive into the development progress and features we've been working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38743264/2afea5cd56a2164da85a3278a21cb665a7d275b0.gif[/img]

[h1]Security Guard - what is this game about??![/h1]

You are a security guard and well your job is to secure something with available tools :D
It's a short desriptions but thats it: You are the head of the small security company and your job is to bring some peace to the world (just some peace...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38743264/fd391407e41e09feb0cc8140fe18b23e5653e8a0.gif[/img]

[h1]Mission Variety[/h1]

We've crafting a wide range of missions that will keep your adrenaline pumping and your heart racing like guarding someone famous - anything can happen! Be aware of terrorists, burglars etc.
And we are preparing missions which are more slower, chillin - like setting up a CCTV systems, making alarms systems and managing your security company!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38743264/c91c0023f9720173d12abebea58ec7500048f88e.gif[/img]

[h1]Gear Up and Get Epic Upgrades![/h1]

As mentioned you will have to use a lot of electronic gadgets and gear to make your work easy - use security cameras, detectors inside houses and buildings and use some non-lethal melee gadgets like taser or tearing gas (sounds familiar? yes, you can use them in our previous game - [i]Prison Simulator[/i] :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38743264/c9cebe4df09005bc3dfbbbb0ab2339b8bb0972b0.gif[/img]

[h1]Show Off Your Skills ![/h1]

In Security Guard, it's all about unleashing your inner hero and proving your mettle. We've combined strategy, stealth, and pulse-pounding action to create a gaming experience that will leave you begging for more.  So you will need fast hands for action segments and a calm mind for managing and opertaing your security company!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38743264/1c4553b30f9c8846e8272f530cdb6f9414e80351.gif[/img]

[h1]Together We Can Make Security Guard Awesome![/h1]

We're not just developers; we're gamers too, and we value your feedback immensely.
Your thoughts, ideas, and suggestions are crucial in shaping the game's development so feel free to share them in comments! 
We're here to create an immersive and enjoyable experience for all of you, and your input will help us achieve that.


Baked Games Team

notes.title: Try out demo of our new game - Plow the Snow !
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!
We wanna invite you - [b]Players [/b]to check out a demo for a new game that we are developing!
This game is called [i]Plow the Snow![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1d67ad0b06f2c99e712213c149b3100db3b3f16.png[/img]

What is it game about? It is a [b]simulator[/b] and [b]casual relaxing[/b] game with a bit cartoony stylized graphic centered around getting rid of the snow in various places !
Help your clients and neighbors get through this winter season. 
You can use multiple machines and brave any obstacle in your path to make the sidewalks and streets free from the snowflake menace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0231325a478a41b61da6d57cded1bef56bbd869f.gif[/img]

[h3]What can you expect in demo version? 
[/h3]

[h3]-Two different levels + garage !

-Great stylized graphic and atmosphere

-Relaxing gameplay and music.

-Fixing stuff in your vehicle in garage! 

-A lot of fun (and a lot of snow to plow) ![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7c07d517acd343d39317b60bf8e6152be0b7a9c1.gif[/img]

Full version will have a lot of levels and also a multiplayer!

Put your gloves on, warm jackets and be ready to Plow the Snow!
Don’t wait, help Snow Angeles to clean up the snow in city !
[h2]Download demo on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist the full game 😉[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967530/Plow_the_Snow/

Players feedback was always close in our hearts and we want to fulfill every player's desire !
Tell us in comments, on Steam Community or on our Discord server what was your's feelings about game ;)

Enjoy and have fun!

Baked Games Team
